test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 09 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: EFHD is related to LMOK in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, OPRN is related to VWYU. To which of the following is JKMI related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- (7) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series.

​So,

 
• 'EFHD’ is written as 'LMOK'

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a29dfa65ec4b1dbaf5caf854e2ed6134b676ee8cd7439597062de1c7a5de2173.png] 

And,

 
• 'OPRN' is written as 'VWYU'

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8b67f4ae3ba4426d5dc7cee7d0c0b472e3fa542debf0901f7b51904dfeaef46b.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• 'JKMI' is written as 

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/147f620145473c3c67941d9e8535509a3df4f65bd06ce8a15236d73ceb02a8c1.png] 

Hence, "**QRTP**" is the correct answer.
